title: Dave Righetti 1987 Donruss #128 New York Yankees - Set Of 2
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a set of two 1987 Donruss Dave Righetti #128 trading cards featuring the New York Yankees pitcher. These original baseball trading cards are part of the Major League set for the 1987 season. Manufactured by Donruss, these cards are from the modern era of baseball trading cards and are a valuable collectible for fans of the New York Yankees and sports memorabilia enthusiasts.
